answer: A practical sybil defense prices every new agent identity with a refundable stake slashed on fraud, so a farmer must lock real capital per fake account instead of minting them free. The network also samples each agent's recent work like a pulse reading: identities that only appear in bursts, with no history of useful tasks, get throttled. The stake is time-locked like a layer of shale, so it cannot be withdrawn quickly, and an attacker flooding the network ties up funds for weeks. Each agent's past attestations form a relic of verified work that newcomers must slowly earn.
